secure_payments.afterCreationTaskerList3: Contract terms cannot be changed after creation
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskeeList1: Refund the Tasker at any time for a full refund (including platform fee)
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskeeList2: Useful if you cannot complete the task

secure_payments.step3StartingList2: Can dispute after completion, or within 24 hours of the start time

secure_payments.step4TaskerList2: More than 24 hours before work is supposed to start

secure_payments.step4TaskeeList3: Useful if the Taskee can't complete the task

secure_payments.faq1Question: What happens if the Tasker doesn't accept my completed task?
secure_payments.faq1Answer: After 7 days, payment goes to you automatically. You don't need to wait.
secure_payments.faq2Question: Can I cancel a contract after work has started?
secure_payments.faq2Answer: Only within 1 hour of creating it, or more than 24 hours before work is supposed to start.
secure_payments.faq3Question: How many times can I propose a resolution during a dispute?
secure_payments.faq3Answer: Up to 2 proposals per party per dispute.
secure_payments.faq4Question: What if we can't agree on a dispute resolution?
secure_payments.faq4Answer: After 14 days, the Tasker can claim a full refund.
secure_payments.faq5Answer: Platform fees are refunded if the contract is cancelled. They're only charged when work is successfully completed.
secure_payments.faq6Answer: Yes, the Taskee can refund you at any time if they can't complete the task.
secure_payments.faq7Question: How is this different from sending payment directly?
secure_payments.faq7Answer: Your funds are held securely until the task is completed. If there's a problem, you have built-in dispute resolution and protection periods.
secure_payments.faq8Question: What if I need to change something after creating the contract?
secure_payments.faq8Answer: Contract terms can't be changed after creation. However, you have cancellation options: Taskers can cancel within 1 hour of creation or more than 24 hours before the start time for a full refund, including platform fees. Taskees can refund the Tasker at any time. This protects both parties by ensuring the agreed terms are followed while providing flexibility when needed.
secure_payments.importantNotesList1: All transactions are final once confirmed on the blockchain
secure_payments.importantNotesList5: Your contract is secure and transparent
